notes: Customer profile: mid-market product analytics SaaS, heavy user-facing chat + search. High concurrency during business hours (1000-3000 queries/min).
Primary goals: reduce per-request cost for embeddings and chat while maintaining p50 latency <200ms for chat; retain control for compliance-sensitive routes.
Quote from Maya (VP Product): 'We want predictable unit economics — if Dedicated reduces cost by 40% for our steady state, it's worth the commitment.'
Cost sensitivity: medium-high. Willing to commit to reserved capacity if ROI demonstrated in 3-6 months. Looking for clear quant tradeoffs (latency vs cost).
Technical ask: support for model pinning, canary rollouts, and automatic fallback to hosted API during Dedicated capacity spikes. Need SDK example for cache TTL and prefix caching patterns.
POC success metrics: avg token cost <= $0.0006 for chat steady state, embedding cost per vector < $0.0009, chat p50 < 200ms, error rate < 0.5%.
Security notes: require SSO (SAML), customer-managed KMS, audit logging retention 1 year, and option for EU-only residency for EMEA customers.
Internal: SE Priya to prepare two quantization profiles (int8 and awq/4-bit baseline) and example batching configs (max_batch_size, dynamic batching windows) for workshop.
They already tried OpenAI hosted endpoints; pain points: variable latency during spikes, opaque unit cost on retries, and no dedicated routing to EU region.
Procurement comments: legal is asking for indemnity language and data residency assurances. Finance wants a 12-month committed discount example.
Logistics: recommended artifacts to send pre-workshop — model perf matrix, sample POC config, pricing worksheet, and an internal benchmark script.

Workload: chat + high-volume embedding generation for product search and reranking. Emphasis on unit economics and predictable per-token costs.

Need clearer delineation of quantization impacts on quality vs token-cost savings.
